parrafo.es: Panes, pasteles, scones y los cinnamon rolls de los que todos hablan, horneados frescos cada mañana en nuestra tienda dentro del 4th Ave Food Park. Pide con anticipación: solemos agotar existencias.
parrafo.en: Breads, pastries, scones and the cinnamon rolls everyone talks about, baked fresh every morning at our shop inside the 4th Ave Food Park. Order ahead, we tend to sell out.

hero.imagen_alt: Fresh breads and pastries on display at BakerBaker in Gainesville

parrafo_1.es: BakerBaker es una panadería familiar en Gainesville dedicada a hornear pasteles, panes, scones y otros productos de repostería frescos, todos los días. Trabajamos tanto con clientes al mostrador como con negocios locales que nos piden al por mayor.
parrafo_1.en: BakerBaker is a family-owned bakery in Gainesville dedicated to crafting fresh, high-quality pastries, breads, scones and other baked goods, every single day. We serve walk-in customers and also supply local cafes, restaurants, schools and businesses as a wholesale partner.

parrafo_2.es: Estamos dentro del 4th Ave Food Park, abiertos de martes a sábado desde las 7am hasta agotar existencias. Si buscas un negocio confiable y de calidad consistente, puedes contarnos qué necesitas.
parrafo_2.en: You will find us inside the 4th Ave Food Park, open Tuesday through Saturday from 7am until we sell out. If you are looking for a reliable bakery you can count on for consistent quality, just tell us what you need.

items.quote: Every time I am in town, I prioritize going to Baker Baker. Amazing pastries and delicious every time. They have a great selection of diverse products, sweet and savory. Some of my favorites are the breakfast mini tart and the maple bun. I recommend to anyone traveling to Gainesville!

As always, their cinnamon rolls are the best in town and likely the best I've ever had. Ordered ahead and my order was ready when I got there. Thank you for such delicious pastries!!! My family is thrilled today :)

I came here for the first time this past Tuesday morning and enjoyed it! BakerBaker is located in the 4th Ave Food Park. The bakery is small and is a to-go type of shop. They are open 7am to sell out Tuesday through Saturday.
